The problem

Marketing decisions are guesses

Most marketing teams allocate budgets based on last year's numbers, gut feeling, or what worked for competitors. They run campaigns in silos with no channel attribution.

  • 40–50% of marketing budget is wasted on underperforming channels
  • Budget is set once and rarely rebalanced
  • Channel crossover effects stay invisible
The solution

AI-powered budget allocation

AI Marketing Copilot replaces guesswork with data-driven decisions. The system continuously analyzes campaign performance, customer behaviour, market trends, historical data and cross-channel effects.

  • Campaign performance — CTR, conversion rate, CPL, CAC in real time
  • Customer behaviour — purchase patterns, LTV, repeat-purchase probability
  • Market trends — seasonality, competitor activity, channel saturation
  • Historical data — budget-to-revenue correlation and channel elasticity
  • Cross-channel effects — how spending on email affects organic conversion
How it works

The AI pipeline

Five stages from raw data to an explainable recommendation.

  1. 1

    1. Data Ingestion

    Connects directly to your Odoo database and marketing platforms (Google Ads, Meta, email providers) via API.

  2. 2

    2. Feature Engineering

    Computes CTR, CAC, LTV, ROAS and budget elasticity for every channel and segment.

  3. 3

    3. Predictive Modeling

    Forecasts next month's conversion rate, segment LTV, optimal budget split and lead-conversion likelihood.

  4. 4

    4. Recommendation Engine

    Turns predictions into actionable steps — increase, pause, shift budget or target commissions.

  5. 5

    5. Audit Trail & Learning

    Logs why each recommendation was made, its confidence score and the actual outcome to improve over time.

FAQ

Getting started

How do I install it?

Search "AI Marketing Copilot" on the Odoo Apps Store and install in two clicks. Demo data (30 sample campaigns, customers and financials) is included.

Does it need configuration?

No. Install, load the demo data and the system generates 5–10 actionable recommendations from your data immediately.

Can I connect my ad platforms?

Yes, optionally. Integrate Google Ads, Meta and email APIs for live data; until then the copilot works from your Odoo data.

Does it stay inside my Odoo?

Yes. All data stays within your Odoo instance — no cloud APIs and no third-party data storage.

Ready to optimize your marketing budget?

Install AI Marketing Copilot on the Odoo Apps Store — completely free, demo data included, no setup required.
